videos.title: The Everyday Hustle with Harleen Nottay
videos.description: Amit Singh Kalley joins Harleen Nottay to share how he went from deputy head teacher in a secondary school to running his own digital online safety business.

videos.title: Asian Network Motivation with Aina
videos.description: Aina is bringing back the lover boys and girls, celebrating grand gestures, old-school romance and unapologetically expressing love for partners, friends and family.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali brings a proper Saturday mix of big tunes including Farooq Got Audio, Diljit Dosanjh and Daddy Yankee. Plus, all the chaos with another round of Guess the Gibberish.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali brings Asian Network Certified for your Saturday bringing Asim Azhar, Dua Lipa and Rasmia Baloch. Smash also spins Pav Dharia, Saweetie and Neha Kakkar.

videos.title: Vallisa
videos.description: Start your weekend with big tunes, brainteasers, and we celebrate Badshah's birthday with This or That - but which banger of his will you chose to play before midday.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with Vallisa
videos.description: JT to Jaz Dhami, Faith Evans to Falguni Pathak - big throwbacks in the mix on Certified.

videos.title: Gura
videos.description: Gura is back, bringing you three hours of great music, good vibes and a special winter edition talkie.

videos.title: Kizzi
videos.description: Kizzi soundtracks your Saturday nights with the biggest and best tunes, Asian anthems and mixes.

videos.title: Pure Spice with DJ Manara
videos.description: Lock into Pure Spice with Manara for a high-energy ride of fresh mixes and flawless blends. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Pure Spice - Takeover
videos.description: DJ Jeevan Music continues his Pure Spice Takeover with his Airplane Mode playlist! Contains strong language.

videos.title: Kizzi
videos.description: Kizzi soundtracks your Saturday nights with the biggest and best tunes, Asian anthems and mixes.

videos.title: Asian Network's Club Hit Squad Mix
videos.description: The night starts here! Get ready for Asian Network Certified with the ultimate pre-party mix from Dee and Rav.

videos.title: Asian Network's Club Hit Squad Mix
videos.description: Dee and Rav are dropping nothing but sauce in this special Club Hit Squad Mix. Think of the biggest Bollywood bangers that turn Diwali parties into all-night raves.

videos.title: Asian Network Celebrates Mumzy Stranger
videos.description: Nadia celebrates one of the defining voices of British Asian Music, as she takes you on a journey of his hits, from One More Dance in 2009, to recent big collabs.

videos.title: Gagan's Throwback Bollywood Mix
videos.description: Join Gagan for Bollywood melodies about love and life without that special someone! This week it's all about the magic of Tere Bin, Tere Bina and lyrics about feeling incomplete.

videos.title: Gagan's Throwback Bollywood Mix
videos.description: Join Gagan Grewal for a Bollywood Diwali Party packed with festive favourites and feel-good throwbacks.

videos.title: Bollywood Sing-Along Anthems
videos.description: The best feelgood Bollywood anthems to get you singing.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali takes over your Sunday with big tunes, easy vibes and a more chilled flow to ease you into the day.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with SMASHBengali
videos.description: SMASHBengali brings Asian Network Certified Throwbacks for 60 minutes where Smash rewinds to the biggest anthems from the good times.

videos.title: Asian Network Bollywood with Gagan Grewal
videos.description: Join Gagan this Sunday for Bollywood classics featuring Arjun Rampal, unforgettable tunes and good fun with the One-Second Game.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi with Dipps Bhamrah
videos.description: Dipps explores The Beautiful Side of Bhangra with 30 minutes of melodic Punjabi favourites from DCS, Sunidhi Chauhan, Balwinder Safri, Saqi and Miss Pooja.

videos.title: Asian Network's Bengali Entertainment Show with Nadia Ali
videos.description: Nadia chats to Bangladesh's entry at Eurovision Asia - Beatmosphere! Plus, more fresh releases you will want to add to your playlist.

videos.title: Asian Network's Pakistani Entertainment Show with Kan D Man
videos.description: Explore the music making waves right now, from established favourites and iconic voices to the next generation of Pakistani artists.

videos.title: Asian Network's South Indian and Tamil Entertainment Show with Pritt
videos.description: Check out sounds from across the Malayalam, Tamil and Telugu music scenes.

videos.title: Bobby Friction
videos.description: Bobby Friction spins music from Diljit Dosanjh, Daddy Yankee, Priya Ragu and Talwiinder. Schooling the Nation puts Anik Khan under the spotlight with the track Cleopatra. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Asian Network Represents
videos.description: From family expectations to finding her voice online, Anyeka Jamal reflects on growing up British Bengali and learning to celebrate her identity on her own terms.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi: Bhangra Bounce
videos.description: Dipps celebrates Rishi Rich with a special Artist Edition of the Bhangra Bounce Mix, featuring Jay Sean, Taz, Mumzy, H-Dhami, Veronica and more.

videos.title: Asian Network Punjabi: Bhangra Bounce
videos.description: This week's Bhangra Bounce Mix explores The Tragic Love Stories of Punjab, bringing together music inspired by some of the most famous tales in Punjabi folklore.

videos.title: Asian Network Evenings with Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa gets you moving out of work mode and ready for the evening - whether you're cooking, getting ready to hit the gym or just chilling at home.

videos.title: BBC Introducing on Asian Network with DJ Manara
videos.description: DJ Manara shares her picks from the BBC Introducing Uploader.

videos.title: Bollywood Sing-Along Anthems
videos.description: Saima serves up Bollywood romance, dancefloor anthems and timeless classics, with favourites including Kajra Re, Chaiyya Chaiyya, Chand Sifarish and Bol Na Halke Halke.

videos.title: The Everyday Hustle with Harleen Nottay
videos.description: Kiren Jogi tells Harleen Nottay how she set up her own theatre community interest company focused around telling stories from the South Asian community.

videos.title: Desi Dancefloor Mix
videos.description: DJ Ishu is stepping into the Desi Dancefloor Mix and blending the slickest sounds. Wherever you are, hit play on the BBC Sounds app or download it and take the vibes with you.

videos.title: Asian Network Breakfast with Nikita Kanda
videos.description: Begin your week listening to Asian Network Breakfast with Nikita Kanda! Ask your smart speaker to play BBC Asian Network.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified with Nikita Kanda
videos.description: Your daily mix of Bollywood, Bhangra, UK garage, R&B, hip-hop and more with Nikita Kanda.

videos.title: Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa is dropping the week's biggest tunes along with plenty of laughter and chat. Wherever you're listening, Vallisa's got the tunes to keep you company.

videos.title: Newsbeat @ 12:45
videos.description: The latest news from around the UK and around the world.

videos.title: Asian Network Bollywood with Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa chats all things Bollywood and reviews the latest films in Rate or Slate. Get in touch with your reviews on what you're watching and hear the biggest Bollywood tracks.

videos.title: Asian Network Certified Throwbacks with Vallisa
videos.description: Vallisa plays big anthems and tunes you haven't heard in ages! From Bollywood, Bhangra, hip-hop, R&B, UK garage and British Asian beats all mashed up.

videos.title: Jaz Singh
videos.description: In honour of Black Friday this week, Jaz wants to hear your best bargain stories.

videos.title: Newsbeat @ 17:45
videos.description: The latest news from around the UK and around the world.

videos.title: Asian Network Evenings with Gura
videos.description: Gura gets you moving out of work mode and ready for the evening - whether you're cooking, getting ready to hit the gym or just chilling at home.

videos.title: Asian Network's New Music Show with DJ Limelight
videos.description: The best new Asian music from the UK and around the world, including DJ Limelight's Coldest Record. Contains strong language.

videos.title: Asian Network Motivation with Aina
videos.description: Aina explores kismet, destiny and life's unexpected twists, reflecting on taking chances, trusting the journey and accepting that not everything is meant to be.

videos.title: Asian Network Trending
videos.description: Prince William takes an electric tuk-tuk for a spin in Mumbai. Earthshot winner Suman Mishra explains how it could help clean up India's air. And reaction to Kate's desi outfit.
